title: console: preview images, PDF, text and CSV in the page from attachments and file fields (Office stays download only)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Development card for decision #34781, option A, ruled by the maintainer on {{WAS:2026-11-22T12:07Z}} (「干脆不预览，只能下载」, then 「A」). Filed by the seat. Parent: #34781. Edition: community, on by default.

## What to build

A shared file preview dialog in the console, opened from a record's attachments and from a file field.

1. Four renderers, no new dependency:
   - Images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP): reuse the fields package's `ImageLightbox`.
   - PDF: an iframe on the browser's own viewer.
   - Plain text.
   - CSV: reuse the parser in plugin-grid's `importParsers` that detects GBK.
2. Controls: previous, next, download, open in a new tab. A "too large, please download" state and an "unsupported type, please download" state.
3. Wire it to `RecordAttachmentsPanel` (the file name opens the preview; download stays in the row's menu) and to the file field (`file-affordance`).
4. Word, Excel and PowerPoint are download only. No browser-side Office renderer, no server conversion, no online Office connector.

## Defaults the maintainer did not object to

- Size limits: images and PDF 20 MB; text and CSV 2 MB or the first 1000 rows. Past a limit, show "too large, please download".
- On a phone, a PDF keeps opening in the system viewer or a new tab. No pdf.js.
- SVG is shown only through an `img` element, never inlined.
- The preview uses the same permission check and the same signed link as download.

## Corrections to the decision card's "what exists today"

- The image field already has a large-image viewer (`ImageLightbox`).
- Download already opens images, PDF and text in a new tab, because the content disposition defaults to inline.

## Acceptance

- From a record's attachments and from a file field, an image, a PDF, a .txt and a .csv each preview in the page on desktop. On a phone, image, text and CSV preview in the page and a PDF opens in the system viewer or a new tab.
- A user who cannot download the file gets the same refusal from the preview.
- A Word, Excel or PowerPoint file offers download only.
- Past a size limit, the dialog shows the "too large" state with a download button.
- SVG and HTML files never execute in the page.

## Sequencing

The seat releases this card for dispatch. Do not claim it before the seat says so; it depends on a prerequisite the seat tracks. The storage and CSP half is its sibling card.

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. A missing feature the maintainer ruled in.
